notes: Intro: Nebula Loop Systems (mid-market SaaS for customer workflows). Evaluated Redwood Hosted API in Q4 2025 for chat + semantic search; early signals positive on model quality and streaming responsiveness. Customer now moving to Dedicated POC to validate cost and deterministic latency under sustained traffic. Key requirements: 99th pct latency < 120ms for chat (typical message length ~40 tokens), throughput target 200 reqs/s peak (burst 500), cost target ~<$0.0015/token effective after batching/quantization. Security: SSO/SAML integration, SOC2 attestation, KMS-managed keys, audit logging, retention controls; EU data residency for EU customers. Deployment: prefer VPC/private subnet with peered connectivity; potential future on-prem migration. Model preferences: prefer an open, Llama-family variant and a quantized 4-bit variant for baseline cost tests; require formal fallback routing plan to smaller model family and cross-region failover (us-east-1 -> eu-west-1) for incident tolerance. POC scope (3 weeks): Week 1 - infra & security (networking, SAML SSO test, KMS key exchange, access controls). Week 2 - Canary rollout: 5% traffic to Dedicated nodes in us-east with tracing, KV-cache warmup, continuous-batching tuned. Week 3 - Scale tests + region failover & rollback drill. Acceptance criteria: meet 95th/99th latency SLOs under defined load, rollback automation completes <2 minutes, cost telemetry visible in Redwood Console and matched to expectations. Pricing: awaiting Dedicated sizing + reserved node quote; finance signal good if ARR $75-150k. Open items: legal needs updated DPA and SAA; need explicit runbook showing model-variant routing & automated fallback; want example rollback playbook in runbook. Quote from product lead: 'If we can show deterministic latency and a clean rollback, we can commit.'
